payload.content: ONLY when the question explicitly asks for the count of *different* / *unique* / *distinct* / *separate* values of a non-unique attribute (e.g. 'how many different cities', 'how many distinct departments'), use COUNT(DISTINCT col). Otherwise use COUNT(*) or COUNT(col) for row counts. Use COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) when counting entities that may appear in multiple rows of a join.

rationale: Bird q_asks_count=yes failures often arise from missing DISTINCT. Predicate: question matches r'\bhow many (different|distinct|unique|separate) \w+'. Tightly gated to avoid always-on misfire.
